title: India e-Tourist Visa for UK Residents | UVS
description: Apply for an India e-Tourist Visa from the UK with expert help. We complete the form and check your photo and passport scan.
intro: The e-Tourist Visa covers holidays, visiting friends and family, and short yoga or wellness courses in India. It is applied for online, and we complete and check the whole application for you.
eligibility: Your nationality is eligible for the Indian eVisa
Your passport is valid for at least six months from arrival
documents: Recent passport-style photo meeting the Indian specifications

faqs.q: How quickly can I get it?
faqs.a: Many eVisas are issued within a few working days. Tell us your travel date and we will advise whether there is time.
